title: A trunk bends without bones
hook: Some flexible structures move without joints.

knows: Animals have structures and behaviors suited to particular conditions.
doesNotKnow: The highlighted muscle directions and curved path represent a flexible muscular trunk. Coordinated muscles can change its shape without bones inside the trunk. The diagram is schematic and does not map all the muscle groups.

misconception: A familiar animal behavior or structure must work in a different way.
objective: What can change an elephant trunk’s shape without a trunk bone?
